Rashi on Berakhot 56a:11:1.english: A barrel - They earned a profit from wine.

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:11:2.hebrew: חלי עסקך - מתוק, כלומר שתתן סחורתך בזול:
Rashi on Berakhot 56a:11:2.english: Your business will be sweet - [Means] sweet; that is to say, you will sell your merchandise cheaply.

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:12:2.hebrew: עשיק עסקך - ביוקר תמכרנו, כמו עשיק לגבך (ב"מ ד' נב.):
Rashi on Berakhot 56a:12:2.english: Make your merchandise dear - You will sell it at a high price, as in: "Make it dear for your back" (Bava Metzia 52a).

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:12:3.hebrew: לרבא א"ל קאוי עסקך - לשון קהוי, הכל ישנאוהו:
Rashi on Berakhot 56a:12:3.english: To Rava he said: Your business will go sour - An expression of setting [the teeth] on edge; everyone will despise it.

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:13:1.hebrew: מתבעי עסקך - יתבקש עסקך, ויחזרו אחריו לקנות:
Rashi on Berakhot 56a:13:1.english: Your merchandise will be in demand - Your merchandise will be sought after, and [people] will pursue it to buy [it].

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:14:1.hebrew: דקאי אאיסדן - מראשותיו, כדמתרגמינן ״מראשותיו״ — ״אסדוהי״ (בראשית כח):
Rashi on Berakhot 56a:14:1.english: Standing near our heads - At his head, as we translate [the word] mera’ashotav [as] isdohi (Genesis 28).

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:14:2.hebrew: מלכא הוית - ראש ישיבה הדורש דרשות, והמתורגמן עומד עליו באמורא להשמיע בקול רם לרבים, כקול חמור הנוער:
Rashi on Berakhot 56a:14:2.english: You will be a king - [That is, the] head of the yeshiva who delivers discourses, and the interpreter stands over him as an amora to make [them] heard in a loud voice to the public, like the sound of a braying donkey.

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:14:3.hebrew: וי"ו דפטר חמור גהיט מתפילך - בפרשת והיה כי יביאך, וכל פטר חמר תפדה בשה, והוא חסר וי"ו. ובתפילין של רבא כתבו הכותב מלא, ואח"כ מחקו. והיינו גהיט — מחוק:
Rashi on Berakhot 56a:14:3.english: The vav of peter chamor is erased from your tefillin - In the passage of Vehaya Ki Yevi'acha, [the verse states]: "And every firstborn of a donkey you shall redeem with a lamb," and it is [written] lacking a vav. And in Rava's tefillin, the scribe wrote it in full, and afterwards erased it. And that is [the meaning of] gehit — erased.

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:15:1.english: The outer door - The outer door of the house.

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:15:2.english: Your wife will die - [For she is the one] who guards the house.

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:15:3.english: Molars - The inner teeth, which are called mâchelières [in Old French].

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:15:4.hebrew: תרתי נשי מגרשת - שאשתו של אדם קרויה יונה, דכתיב: יונתי תמתי:
Rashi on Berakhot 56a:15:4.english: You will divorce two women - For a man's wife is called a dove, as it is written: "My dove, my perfect one."

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:15:5.english: You have received two blows with a club - A blow of a stick thick at its head like the heads of turnips.

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:16:1.hebrew: בלא מצרים - נחלה בלא מצרים, כלומר: קרקעות רחבים ורבים:
Rashi on Berakhot 56a:16:1.english: Without boundaries - An inheritance without boundaries, that is to say, extensive and numerous lands.

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:16:2.english: And the covering of its dust - A covering of dust that flies from the collapse of the wall.

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:16:3.english: And his brain fell out - His brain fell out.

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:16:4.english: Stuffing from the pillow - The stuffing is coming out of the pillow that is at his head.

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:16:5.hebrew: הללא מצראה - הלל שאנו קורין בפסח. לפי שיש הלל אחר הקרוי הלל הגדול, קורין לזה הלל המצרי:
Rashi on Berakhot 56a:16:5.english: The Egyptian Hallel - The Hallel that we recite on Passover. Since there is another Hallel that is called the Great Hallel, this [one] is called the Egyptian Hallel.

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:16:6.hebrew: ניסי מתרחשי לך - שע"י נסים נקרא, ניסן — שעל כל צרה הבאה לישראל, אומרים אותו על גאולתן:
Rashi on Berakhot 56a:16:6.english: Miracles will be performed for you - For on account of miracles it is recited, over their miracle — as for every trouble that comes upon Israel, they recite it upon their redemption.

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:17:1.english: [He] was going - Bar Hedya [was going] with Rava.

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:17:2.english: In a boat - In a ship.

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:17:3.hebrew: אמר בהדי גברא דמתרחיש ליה ניסא למה לי - שמא כאן יארע לו הנס, שתטבע הספינה והוא ינצל:
Rashi on Berakhot 56a:17:3.english: [He] said: Why do I [need to go] with a man for whom a miracle occurs? - Lest here the miracle will occur for him — that the ship will sink and he will be saved.

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:17:4.hebrew: בדידך קיימא - בך הוא תלוי הפתרון — אם לטובה, אם לרעה — והפכת לי לרעה:
Rashi on Berakhot 56a:17:4.english: [It] depended on you - The interpretation was dependent on you — whether for good or for bad — and you turned [it] to bad for me.

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:17:5.hebrew: אשתו של רבא - בת רב חסדא היתה:
Rashi on Berakhot 56a:17:5.english: Rava's wife - She was the daughter of Rav Ḥisda.

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:19:1.english: The keeper of the king's wardrobe - The keeper of the king's treasury.

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:19:2.english: A worm fell - [Tikhla means] a worm.

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:1:1.hebrew: קיסר - מלך רומי, והיה לו תגר עם פרסיים:
Rashi on Berakhot 56a:1:1.english: Caesar - The king of Rome, and he had a conflict with the Persians.

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:1:2.hebrew: מאי חזינא - מאי אראה בלילה בחלום:
Rashi on Berakhot 56a:1:2.english: What I will see - What I will see at night in a dream.

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:1:3.hebrew: משחרי לך פרסאי - עושים בך עבודת המלך, כמו לא חמרא דחד מנהון שחרית (תרגום במדבר יו), ולשון חכמים (ספרי פ' דברים): הדבק לשחוור וישתחוו לך:
Rashi on Berakhot 56a:1:3.english: The Persians will press you into service - They will make you perform the service of the king, as in: "I did not seize for service the donkey of [even] one of them" (Targum to Numbers 16), and in the language of the Sages (Sifrei, Parashat Devarim): "Attach yourself to a royal officer, and [people] will bow down to you."

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:1:5.english: And take you captive - They will take you as plunder into captivity.

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:1:6.hebrew: וטחנו בך קשייתא - יכופו אותך לטחון גרעיני תמרים:
Rashi on Berakhot 56a:1:6.english: And grind date pits with you - They will force you to grind date pits.

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:2:1.english: Your business will be lost - Your merchandise will be ruined.

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:2:2.english: And you will derive no pleasure from eating - Due to your grief, no food will taste good to you.

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:2:3.hebrew: מרווח עסקך - ומתוך שמחתך לא תתאוה לאכול, שתהיה שבע בשמחתך:
Rashi on Berakhot 56a:2:3.english: Your business will profit - And out of your joy, you will not desire to eat, for you will be sated with your joy.

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:5:1.english: To allay your fear - To dispel your anxiety.

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:6:1.english: From its beginning - [Namely:] "You shall carry much seed out into the field."

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:8:1.hebrew: בדיינא דמלכא - אוצר שתכשיטי המלך שם, ישבר על ידי גנבים, ויעלילו עליך לומר שאתה גנבתם:
Rashi on Berakhot 56a:8:1.english: The king's treasury - A treasury where the king's ornaments are [kept] will be broken into by thieves, and they will falsely accuse you, saying that you stole them.

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:8:2.hebrew: קל וחומר מינך - אם רבא נחשד, כל שכן שיחשדונו. וזהו: וייראו ממך:
Rashi on Berakhot 56a:8:2.english: An a fortiori inference from you - If Rava is suspected, all the more so will they suspect us. And this is [the meaning of]: "And they shall be afraid of you."

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:9:2.hebrew: עיף עסקך - כפול בריוח, כחזרת שהיא רחבה וכפולה:
Rashi on Berakhot 56a:9:2.english: Your business will double - [It will be] doubled in profit, like lettuce, which is broad and folded.

Rashi on Berakhot 56a:9:3.hebrew: מריר עסקך - שנאוי לכל ומר יהיה הסחורה שלך:
Rashi on Berakhot 56a:9:3.english: Your business will be bitter - Your merchandise will be hated by all and bitter.
